## What changes?

Describe the problem, the change and the user-visible effect. Link the issue, if any.

## Evidence

- Tested revision (and any uncommitted changes):
- Environment and relevant worker/toolchain details:
- Exact commands and exit codes:
- Actual passed / failed / skipped results, with skip reasons:
- Blocked or not run:

Use a concise sanitized summary. Do not upload raw logs, diagnostic bundles or private projects. A historical local test count or a workflow file is not evidence that this revision passed CI.

## Visual or performance changes

If applicable, provide a small generated reproduction, exact image/print settings and before/after results. State geometry mode, preferred/minimum label size and which preview/project/export paths were checked. For performance, compare the same case and separate computation, UI work and confirmation wait time. Otherwise write “Not applicable”.

## Risks and compatibility

Note project-schema changes, dependencies, regressions, packaging effects and how to revert the change safely.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes a regression test where applicable.
- [ ] I recorded actual checks and disclosed failures, skips and untested paths.
- [ ] I did not weaken preflight, silently lower readable label size, erase meaningful details or enlarge the page to hide a failure.
- [ ] No user artwork, commercial book pages, private projects, raw logs, decompiled/proprietary material, secrets, private addresses or local machine paths are included.
- [ ] Any new fixture is redistributable and has a documented source or generation method.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this work under GPL-3.0-only for original code; third-party licenses and notices remain intact.
- [ ] Documentation and dependency/provenance notices are updated where needed.

The code license does not place user artwork or generated output under the GPL.
